title: Controllers: Basic, Invokable aur Resource
objectives: Basic, invokable aur resource controllers ka farak samajhna
Controller mein `Request` aur response (view, JSON, redirect) use karna
prerequisites: Named Routes, Route Groups aur Special Routes (m04-l03)

sections.heading: Basic controller
sections.body: Closure ki jagah controller class use karne se related logic ek jagah rehta hai. Controller `app/Http/Controllers` mein hote hain.

code.code:
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class UserController extends Controller
{
    public function show(string $id): View
    {
        return view('user.profile', [
            'user' => User::findOrFail($id),
        ]);
    }
}

explain: Controller ke saare public methods requests handle kar sakte hain.
Controller ko base class extend karna zaroori nahi hai, par shared methods ke liye convenient hota hai.

sections.heading: Invokable controller
sections.body: Agar controller sirf ek kaam karta hai, to ek `__invoke` method wali class banao.
explain: Route par method ka naam nahi dena padta, sirf class ka naam.

sections.heading: Real-world example: Resource controller
sections.body: Products ke liye create, read, update, delete sab chahiye. Ek command aur ek route line 7 routes bana deti hai.
explain: `make:controller ... --api` API resource controller banata hai jisme `create` aur `edit` nahi hote.

callout.text: Resource route ke saath koi extra route chahiye (jaise `/products/popular`), to use `Route::resource` se **pehle** likho, warna `{product}` use pakad lega.

sections.heading: Request aur Response basics
sections.body: Controller method mein `Request` type-hint karo aur input lo. Response ke kai roop ho sakte hain.
explain: `$request->input('name')` – POST body ya query dono se.
Array return karo to Laravel use JSON bana deta hai.

sections.heading: Controller middleware
sections.body: Middleware route par ya controller ke andar lagaya ja sakta hai. Controller mein `HasMiddleware` interface use hota hai.
explain: `auth`, `log`, `subscribed` middleware ke naam hain (Module 13 mein detail).
`only` / `except` se kuch methods tak limit karte hain.

versionDiff.heading: Controller middleware: Laravel 11, 12 aur 13
versionDiff.intro: Resource aur invokable controllers teeno versions mein same hain. Laravel 13 mein controller middleware ke liye PHP attributes bhi milte hain.

items.11: `HasMiddleware` interface se controller middleware. Base `Controller` mein `$this->middleware()` nahi hota.
items.13: `HasMiddleware` ab bhi chalta hai. Saath mein attributes: `#[Middleware('auth')]`, `#[WithoutMiddleware(...)]` aur policies ke liye `#[Authorize(...)]` (13 docs ke hisaab se).

errors.error: The POST method is not supported for route products. Supported methods: GET, HEAD
errors.cause: Form POST kar raha hai par us URL ka POST route nahi hai.
errors.fix: `Route::post(...)` ya `Route::resource` jodo aur form ka `action` check karo.
Form ke andar `@csrf` likho (aur PUT/DELETE ke liye `@method('PUT')`).

errors.cause: Route mein method ka naam galat hai, ya controller mein method banaya nahi.
errors.fix: Naam ka spelling check karo aur method banao.

debug.body: Resource routes ke naam, methods aur controller actions `route:list` mein dikhte hain.

code.code:
php artisan route:list --path=products
php artisan route:list --name=products

tasks: Har method se ek chhota text return karo aur browser mein `GET` routes test karo
Resource ko `only(['index', 'show'])` tak limit karo aur `route:list` dobara dekho

quiz.why: index, create, store, show, edit, update, destroy: kul 7 routes.
API ke liye HTML form wale `create` aur `edit` routes nahi bante.

quiz.q: Invokable controller mein kaunsa method hota hai?
quiz.why: Single action controller mein `__invoke` method hota hai.

interview.a: Aisa controller jisme CRUD ke standard 7 methods hote hain, aur `Route::resource` ek line mein unke routes bana deta hai.

interview.q: Invokable controller kab use karte hain?
interview.a: Jab controller sirf ek kaam karta ho, `__invoke` method ke saath.
Resource routes mein se chune hue actions hi register karte hain ya kuch hata dete hain.

interview.q: Controller mein middleware kaise lagate hain?
interview.a: Route par `->middleware()`, `HasMiddleware` interface se, ya Laravel 13 mein `#[Middleware]` attribute se.
Controller method mein `Request $request` jaisi dependency type-hint karna, jise container inject karta hai. Route parameters uske baad likhte hain.

summary: `make:controller` se controller banta hai; `--invokable` aur `--resource` variants hain.
Resource route 7 routes deta hai, `only`/`except` se kam kar sakte ho.
Controller mein `Request` inject karke input lo, view/JSON/redirect return karo.
Middleware ke liye `HasMiddleware`, aur Laravel 13 mein attributes bhi.
